label: HP EliteBook 840 14-inch G10
description: 14-inch aluminium business ultrabook, 13th-gen Core U/P, two Thunderbolt 4 plus HDMI 2.1 and Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: No RJ45 on the 840 G10: HP moved wired connectivity to the dock (2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB-A, HDMI only). Wired needs a USB-C dock/dongle at 1GbE; Wi-Fi 6E AX211 plus optional 5G WWAN onboard.
